content:
name: Temporary WP-MVP-0005 Ready transaction

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - eosp/ready-wp-mvp-0005
    paths:
      - .eos/wp-mvp-0005-ready-trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  ready:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 25
    steps:
      - name: Check out exact EOSP branch
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
      - name: Execute governed Ready transaction
        shell: bash
        run: bash .eos/tmp-ready-wp-mvp-0005.sh
